outcome: duration of second stage of labor
cohort: 100 primigravidae with term gestation and uncomplicated pregnancies admitted to the labor room were studied.
finding: Induction of labor in primigravidae is associated with higher cesarean rates, increased perineal tears, prolonged labor, and a poorer childbirth experience compared to spontaneous labor.
mod_finding: Cesarean section rates were significantly higher in induced labor (33%) compared to spontaneous labor (11%).
